description: This file defines data structures, inline functions, and macros for managing and accessing arena statistics within jemalloc, including atomic operations, mutex handling, and statistics for large allocations and decay processes.

classes.name: arena_stats_large_t
classes.description: Structure holding statistics for large allocations within an arena, including counts of mallocs, frees, requests, and current extents.

classes.name: arena_stats_decay_t
classes.description: Structure holding decay-related statistics such as purge sweeps, madvise calls, and pages purged.

classes.name: arena_stats_t
classes.description: Main structure aggregating various statistics for an arena, including mapped memory, retained memory, decay info, large allocation stats, and uptime.

methods.name: arena_stats_init
methods.description: Initializes an arena_stats_t structure, optionally checking that it is zeroed and initializing its mutex if needed.

methods.name: arena_stats_lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex associated with arena_stats_t if mutex is used.

methods.name: arena_stats_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex associated with arena_stats_t if mutex is used.

methods.name: arena_stats_read_u64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned statistic from arena_stats_t, using atomic load if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_add_u64
methods.description: Adds a value to a 64-bit unsigned statistic within arena_stats_t, using atomic fetch_add if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_sub_u64
methods.description: Subtracts a value from a 64-bit unsigned statistic within arena_stats_t, using atomic fetch_sub if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_accum_u64
methods.description: Non-atomically adds a value to a statistic, requiring external synchronization.

methods.name: arena_stats_read_zu
methods.description: Reads a size_t statistic from arena_stats_t, using atomic load if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_add_zu
methods.description: Adds a size_t value to a statistic within arena_stats_t, using atomic fetch_add if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_sub_zu
methods.description: Subtracts a size_t value from a statistic within arena_stats_t, using atomic fetch_sub if supported.

methods.name: arena_stats_accum_zu
methods.description: Non-atomically adds a size_t value to a statistic, requiring external synchronization.

methods.name: arena_stats_large_nrequests_add
methods.description: Locks the arena stats, adds nrequests to the specified size class, then unlocks.

methods.name: arena_stats_mapped_add
methods.description: Locks the arena stats, adds size to the mapped memory statistic, then unlocks.
